name: manual_b43b69
claim: The scout-block ignore-file hook resolves its allow list from the shell's current directory, so a worktree kept outside the workspace tree has none until one is added there. When it blocks, report the block and ask for a narrow allow-list entry.

decisions.notes: Draft worktrees had no allow list; the operator approved narrow entries for scratch logs and server logs.

rationale: Draft worktrees had no allow list; the operator approved narrow entries for scratch logs and server logs.
